rig_naming.contact_point: key-press / click contact = fingertip tip = Index4_end
rig_naming.scope: hand + right-arm shaping (shoulder/upper-arm/elbow/wrist via per-frame arm_pose) for now; non-hand effectors (torso/eye) get rig_bone null + pending_full_body_rig until full-body rig is provided

manual_buffer.manual_buffer_command: manual_buffer issues PRESSING command to right_index_fingertip_pad (rig_bone: mixamorig:RightHandIndex4_end) for KF-1-5.
manual_buffer.scene_contact_point_comment: Unity WORLD-space point the right index fingertip presses (NOT the backend 'coordinates'/'ik_target' above, which are UI-space). left_mouse_button is enlarged at runtime so its top rises to hand height, so this is left at 0,0,0 = AUTO: the finger targets the resized visible TOP automatically. To pin an exact point, copy the 'Auto visible-top = (...)' value from the [KleinPress] console log into x/y/z.

rig_pose.side_comment: Which arm/hand this frame drives. All bone names below are the RIGHT-side mixamo bones; the motor wires exactly these bones (no hardcoded guessing). Mirror to mixamorig:Left* for the left hand.

arm_chain.comment: Bones the two-bone arm IK rotates to carry the hand to the contact. shoulder=clavicle, upper_arm=shoulder joint, forearm=elbow, hand=wrist.

finger_bones.comment: Per-finger joint chains (base -> tip) the hand_pose angles bend. 'index' also drives the press contact (its last bone is the end_effector fingertip). These are the exact bones the rig wires for this frame.

hand_pose.comment: Per-joint bend in DEGREES toward the palm. mcp = base knuckle, pip = middle joint, dip = tip joint. Index kept nearly straight to point; middle/ring/pinky curled into the palm; thumb relaxed. All angles read live from this file.

arm_pose.comment: Right-arm shaping ONLY (shoulder -> upper arm -> elbow -> wrist; NOT the full body rig). The arm two-bone IK reaches the button from the FRONT with the elbow folded down-and-out, so the hand raises from the front instead of swinging up from the spine, and the limb never passes through the torso. All values read live from this file.

elbow_pole.comment: Where the elbow is pulled, in METRES from the shoulder, in the character's own axes. forward (+) keeps the elbow in front of the chest so the arm reaches from the front; side (+) folds it out to the character's right so it clears the torso; down (+) drops it below the shoulder. The forward term is what stops the elbow folding behind the backbone.

reach.comment: Forward reach envelope (metres from the shoulder) for the approach, the clavicle lift (degrees) as the hand rises toward the contact, and the wrist hover (metres) so the down-pointing fingertip settles onto the top surface instead of stopping in the air.

rest.comment: Held arm pose between presses. forearm_bend_deg gives the idle arm a slight natural elbow bend instead of hanging ramrod-straight.

manual_buffer.motor_execution: motor_module executes KF-1-5 by event physical-event contact-event press-event mouse-button-press left_mouse_button with right_index_fingertip_pad, stores frame into declarative_module.stored_frames[].
